profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at MyHealthTeam
profile.summary: Hello my name is Arturo Lopez, and I graduated from CSU, Monterey Bay with a degree in Computer Science through the CS-in-3 program. My passion consist of creating mobile and web applications but always on the chase to find new challenging things to learn!  My career goal is to be the best Software Engineer I can be by pushing myself every single day and expand the greatness of Computer Science towards other people, especially in my community.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for developing the front-end for the modernize Diamond web application using React.JS. Diamond is a responsive web application that increases organizations productivity by containing a central hub of methodologies that can be imported into project plans. Won over the project’s product owner by designing detailed wire frames of every screen state of the project.  Material Design, a design language developed by Google is being used to implement the user interface. Writing unit test using the Mocha testing framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked with the Salesforce platform by modifying the data model for a Salesforce community app with over 6,000 users to improve performance and extensibility. Created a new user interface for the forums page using AngularJS and refactored backend code.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
I was accountable for developing and testing front/back end improvements for Must Win's internal application (scoreboard.ly). I worked closely with my mentor that developed Scoreboard these last two years. I enhanced Scoreboard’s integration with Github and improved the invoices section by allowing users to void invoices. I also worked on the UI throughout the application. 

During my internship I learned Ruby on Rails, improved my Javascript, Coffeescript, HTML/CSS skills. A challenge I had was working with Chef in order to get the server up and running again after a change occurred in the configuration file for Scoreboard.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer Intern
positions.description: Mobile developer intern at Hopkins Marine Station of Stanford University. In that role I learned Swift while recreating their iOS mobile application. In the new app version, improvements were made in the front end and the back end with the final goal of creating an improved user experience. Some improvements include simplifying the data storage method and displaying the most popular feature of the app automatically when the app is opened. Through this internship I was challenged by having novice experience with creating appealing user interfaces.

company.name: Hopkins Marine Station of Stanford University

positions.title: TA for Capstone Course
positions.description: Managed the capstone projects for the TA capstone course. I updated the students grades based on their weekly achievements and goals. Handled students concerns with the course and challenges they encountered with their project. Frequently collaborated with the professor with a objective to improve the course for the next semester. Assisted with organizing the capstone festival in which students display their final product to industry partners, friends and family.

positions.title: Peer-Led Team Learning Leader
positions.description: My main objective as a PLTL leader was to guide five CS students through weekly problem-solving sessions focused on introductory concepts. I prepared weekly exercises with the CS-in-3 education program manager in order to have an efficient PLTL meeting. I taught them the way a computer compiles codes,testing through JUnit, how to improve their problem solving skills, and basic programming skills. One of the best experiences I had as a PLTL leader was seeing the students reaction after solving a difficult problem as a group. Being a PLTL leader was highly important to me because I gained experience and confidence with explaining a programming problem step by step.

positions.title: Student Accountability Group Leader
positions.description: As a Student Accountability Group leader, I monitored five students from the CS-in-3 cohort. I had weekly meetings with my group to get updates on their weekly academic objectives. I assisted my team members iron out any roadblocks that prevented them from obtaining proficient grades. As a SAG leader I organized study sessions and events for the CS-in-3 cohort.

volunteerExperiences.description: Created a web application prototype for the Wahine project with the main objective of being able to retrieve the basic volunteers information.

projects.title: Stop Illegal Trawling on the Ghanaian Coast Android Mobile Application
projects.description: Ghana's coastal waters are protected by law from bottom trawling for fish, which can both damage sensitive natural habitats needed to support the country's fisheries, and also come into direct conflict with small-scale fishing activities in the same area. To help address this problem, together with broader enforcement of fishing laws and regulations, the Government of Ghana recently established a Fisheries Enforcement Unit (FEU). While this unit has a number of patrol boats and surveillance tools available to it, perhaps none could be as effective as the thousands of small-scale fishers who are active on the water every day, and could serve as eyes and ears for the authorities - and who in fact have the most to gain from a reduction in illegal bottom trawling.

projects.title: West Africa Registration
projects.description:
Many West African countries are now trying to develop fishing registration and licensing systems for small-scale fisheries.Through the West Africa Regional Fisheries Program (WARFP) funded by World Bank, Cape Verde, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Liberia and Ghana are in the process of registering, licensing and monitoring the entire commercial small-scale fishing fleet representing at least 30,000 canoes.

Our team designed a registration and database prototype through the use of the Django web framework. This application was rendered to scale mobile devices using HTML5, and CSS3
